title: 49th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/49/2024).
First reading of the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Commission Bill, submitted by Thulhaadhoo MP Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru.
Debate on the proposed State Budget for 2025 continues, under Article 96(a) of the Constitution.
Continued debate on the Bill amending the Penal Code (Law No. 9/2014), submitted on behalf of the government by Maafushi MP Hussain Riza Adam.
Committee of the Whole House report on its review of the Bill amending the Political Parties Act (Law No. 4/2013).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting gave first reading to a Media and Broadcasting Commission bill, continued the 2025 budget debate and the Penal Code amendment debate, and took up a committee report on the Political Parties Act amendment.
